provenance: Executed local account API; synthetic Radar identity and Razorpay responses; no live payment

features.name: search_companies
features.description: Filter companies by industry, market, location, size, stage, technology, funding and financial bands.

features.name: semantic_company_search
features.description: Find companies using a natural-language description plus optional filters.

features.name: get_company
features.description: Retrieve a deep company profile: sectors, feeds, founders, technology, traffic, apps, products, geography, hiring and innovation; selectable sections with explicit coverage.

features.name: get_company_intelligence
features.description: Read company scores, peer comparisons, earnings and risk narratives. Scores are derived assessments, not financial facts.

features.name: get_financials
features.description: Retrieve income, balance-sheet and cash-flow metrics by fiscal period; distinguish filings from news reports and preserve currency and access limits.

features.name: get_company_events
features.description: Read a company's event timeline, momentum, risks and the effective account-limited date window.

features.name: get_company_funding
features.description: Read reported funding rounds and investors; retain approximate-amount flags.

features.name: get_company_enrichment
features.description: Read legal identity, hiring, reputation, digital presence, innovation and social activity when available.

features.name: find_competitors
features.description: Find competitors in a named market, grouped by funding stage.

features.name: company_brief
features.description: Combine profile, financials, intelligence, events, enrichment, funding and linked news; report each unavailable section explicitly.

features.name: compare_companies
features.description: Compare two to five companies with separately labelled fiscal periods and partial-coverage flags.

features.name: search_investors
features.description: Find investors by headquarters and portfolio industries or markets.

features.name: investor_directory
features.description: List published investor pages, sectors and cities.

features.name: get_investor_page
features.description: Retrieve a published investor profile or investor list by the slug from investor_directory.

features.name: market_pulse
features.description: Read recent funding, trending markets, sectors and investors for a bounded window.

features.name: location_intelligence
features.description: Retrieve Radar's existing business intelligence for a named location.

features.name: discover_industries
features.description: Find up to five matching industry or market names using a specific query.

features.name: search_jobs
features.description: Find job listings by company, skills, role, geography and freshness.

features.name: companies_hiring
features.description: Find hiring companies for the same job filters.

features.name: get_job
features.description: Retrieve a job listing by an ID returned by search_jobs.

features.name: salary_benchmark
features.description: Read salary statistics for a role, geography and optional currency; retain sample size and coverage.

features.name: search_people
features.description: Find professional profiles by name, role, company, skills and location; no contact-reveal actions.

features.name: search_news
features.description: Search associated news; a company filter uses business-news coverage. Headlines default to 100 per page.

features.name: search_business_news
features.description: Search business headlines for a topic or company with date, sentiment and priority filters.

features.name: news_overview
features.description: Read measured coverage, headline examples and topic context in a bounded date window.

features.name: news_trends
features.description: Measure daily, weekly or monthly news volume while preserving the available date window.

features.name: news_sentiment
features.description: Read the distribution and timeline of news sentiment.

features.name: search_business_events
features.description: Read structured business events associated with a topic or company and their article references.

features.name: search_funding_news
features.description: Find funding coverage by company, topic, investor, sector, round and reported USD amount.

features.name: get_article
features.description: Retrieve the full article and attribution for an article ID returned by news or company events.

hash_basis: Parsed JSON with sorted keys, after any credential redaction
